title: Planner bundle manifest (bundle/manifest.json)
description: Version 0.2.0 (2026-10-19): a file may declare vaults.schema.json. Version 0.1.0 (2026-10-18). Written by gym-skill-extract next to the public bundle it ships to the routine planner (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4; the bundle landed in refactor step 3: build_bundle.py). The planner's sync checks every file's sha256 against it and rejects a schema_version whose major differs from its own.

catalogs.description: Discipline -> catalog version (the same hash as in catalog_*.json and aliases_*.json).

sources.description: Repo -> commit of the content that went into the bundle.

files.description: Every bundle file (path relative to bundle/, '/' separators) -> sha256 of its bytes and the schema it validates against.

schema.description: Schema file name in schema/, if the file has one.
